QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] The Fleeting Joy of Wartime Reunion
QuestInfo.0: In Akihabara, Tokyo, the stranded soldiers and civilians have built a resistance base. From there, they're coordinating with the ZDF soldiers to launch a coordinated attack with the ultimate weapon, pushing toward what should be a final victory. But in another 'correction' to the timeline, the machines have learned the base's location early, and they're heading to attack it now. Time warp to Akihabara in 2102, and defend the command center.
QuestInfo.1: You've arrived to reinforce the command center, and reunited with #p9401527#. Report to #p9401528# for more information.
QuestInfo.2: Independent Task Force Iruvata sounds dangerous. Before you engage them, see what you can learn about them from #p9120032#.
